title: Raising Operator
description: Essential Criteria: The student must demonstrate that the raising operator has no normalizable eigenfunctions.

title: Lowering Operator
description: Essential Criteria: The student must show that the lowering operator has normalizable eigenfunctions.

title: Expectation Values
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the expectation values of x, x^2, p, and p^2 in the coherent state.

title: Uncertainty Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must find the uncertainties sigma_x and sigma_p and demonstrate that the uncertainty relation is saturated.

title: Coefficient Expansion
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the coefficients in the expansion of the coherent state in terms of energy eigenstates and normalize it.

title: Time Evolution
description: Important Criteria: The student should show how the coherent state evolves in time and remains an eigenstate of the lowering operator.

title: Ground State Coherence
description: Essential Criteria: The student must confirm that the ground state is a coherent state and provide the corresponding eigenvalue.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating expectation values or normalizing coefficients incorrectly.
